description:
**Role description**

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at www.ust.com

Job Description: Coupa System Admin

**Job Title:** Coupa System Admin  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Locations:** Trivandrum, Chennai, Kochi, Pune, Bangalore, Noida, Kolkata

Basic Function

The Coupa System Admin is responsible for advanced administration, configuration, technical ownership, solution design, and enterprise enablement of the Coupa platform. The role focuses on Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Supplier Management, and related Source-to-Pay capabilities.

As a Coupa subject matter expert and escalation point, the role handles complex configuration, integration, data, access, and production issues. The position focuses on non-routine problem-solving, platform scalability, project delivery, and long-term risk reduction.

The role also involves collaborating with business stakeholders, leading User Acceptance Testing (UAT), supporting change management processes, mentoring junior administrators, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve procurement processes and outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

### **Primary Responsibilities – Coupa**

* Lead advanced configuration and administration across Coupa Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Management, and related Source-to-Pay capabilities.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable functional and technical solutions across Coupa configuration areas.
* Lead configuration workstreams for new implementations, global rollouts, continuous improvement initiatives, and new capability enablement.
* Assess cross-module and upstream/downstream impacts before introducing changes, with particular attention to Procurement, Accounts Payable, Supplier, Contract, and ERP dependencies.
* Own complex production issue resolution through root-cause analysis, durable corrective actions, and preventive improvements.
* Review Coupa release notes and product roadmap updates, evaluate business impact, and recommend platform improvements and process efficiencies.

### **Technical, Integration & Data Expertise**

* Maintain strong knowledge of Coupa configuration, data structures, module dependencies, release behavior, and Source-to-Pay process design.
* Design, support, and optimize integrations between Coupa and ERP, middleware, identity, supplier, payment, reporting, and other enterprise platforms using APIs, file-based interfaces, and scheduled data feeds.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, validation rules, error handling, reconciliation processes, and technical support documentation.
* Partner with internal IT teams, middleware providers, Coupa Support, and external vendors on solution design, troubleshooting, defect resolution, release coordination, and regression risk management.
* Establish and enforce data quality, access, security, and governance controls aligned with enterprise compliance requirements.

### **AI, Automation & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, Generative AI, automation, and agent-based capabilities to improve Source-to-Pay processes, decision support, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Procurement stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and AI governance groups to define use cases, requirements, controls, and success measures.
* Coordinate requirements for Coupa AI capabilities and agent-based solutions.
* Apply working knowledge of AI/ML, Generative AI, orchestration, prompt design, and responsible AI principles when evaluating or implementing solutions.
* Monitor the Coupa roadmap and procurement technology market for relevant AI developments while ensuring confidentiality, data integrity, and appropriate human oversight.
* Share practical guidance that strengthens the team's understanding of AI concepts and their responsible application within procurement technology.

### **Testing, Release & Platform Reliability**

* Develop test strategies and lead end-to-end validation, regression testing, UAT, defect tracking, release readiness, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Maintain configuration timelines, decision logs, test evidence, defect matrices, runbooks, and functional and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with business and technical stakeholders to confirm production readiness, cutover activities, support coverage, and rollback considerations.
* Use reporting and data analysis to assess change impacts, identify trends, support compliance requirements, and improve platform reliability.

### **Project & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as a Coupa technical subject matter expert for enterprise projects, global initiatives, and Source-to-Pay transformation programs.
* Lead or support requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design reviews, solution decisions, and stakeholder alignment.
* Communicate complex information effectively to business, technical, vendor, and leadership audiences.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and design review support to other administrators to strengthen overall platform maturity.

### **Change Management & CAB Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with project management teams to track changes through tools such as Jira and ServiceNow.
* Ensure changes follow established change-control processes, including accurate documentation, logs, and approvals.
* Prepare change management documentation, including change request forms and impact assessments.
* Present proposed changes during Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, clearly communicating risks, mitigations, and deployment plans.
* Support post-change reviews and compliance audits while driving continuous improvement in change management processes.

### **Additional Responsibilities – Preferred**

* Working knowledge of SAP Concur or other financial systems supporting Travel, Expense, Procurement, Invoicing, or Accounts Payable processes.
* Understanding of how Coupa interacts with SAP-based ERP systems, SAP Concur, middleware, identity platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ability to support cross-platform impact analysis and integrated Procure-to-Pay and Travel-and-Expense process design.

Role Scope & Accountability

* Manage Coupa as an enterprise platform with accountability for advanced technical enablement, scalability, reliability, and risk reduction.
* Operate independently, lead significant project activities, and solve complex problems involving multiple systems and dependencies.
* Act as an escalation point for complex production issues, configuration decisions, integration impacts, vendor technical engagement, and release risks.
* Drive alignment on configuration standards, documentation, governance, and long-term platform health.

Job Qualifications

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience**, including demonstrated experience administering or implementing Coupa in a complex enterprise environment.
* Hands-on Coupa configuration experience across Procurement and one or more related modules such as Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Supplier Management.
* Strong business knowledge of Source-to-Pay processes, including procurement, supplier management, contracts, sourcing, invoicing, and Accounts Payable.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware, master data, access models, and technical troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to manage complex system changes, testing, release readiness, defect resolution, documentation, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including evaluation of relevant use cases, risks, controls, and responsible implementation considerations.
* Exposure to implementing AI/Generative AI capabilities, automation, orchestration tools, or agent-based solutions within Coupa or another procurement application.
* Knowledge of Coupa AI capabilities, product roadmap, Community, support processes, and release-management practices.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP Concur and integrated Travel, Expense, Procurement, or Procure-to-Pay ecosystems.
* Exposure to SAP ERP, middleware platforms, Identity and Access Management (IAM), enterprise reporting, and global financial-system deployments.

title: IT AND SYSTEM ADMIN
description:
Job Description – IT Administrator

**Department:** Information Technology / Administration  
**Designation:** IT Administrator  
**Location:** Chennai / Multiple Store Locations  
**Industry:** Retail – Footwear & Apparel

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and technically capable IT Administrator to manage IT infrastructure, CCTV monitoring, system troubleshooting, networking coordination, electronic equipment maintenance, asset tracking, and vendor management across our retail stores and office locations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth IT operations, timely issue resolution, proper asset control, and effective vendor coordination.

Key Responsibilities

**1. CCTV Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Monitor CCTV systems across stores and office locations to ensure proper functioning.
* Troubleshoot camera, DVR/NVR, recording, and remote-access issues.
* Coordinate with service providers for CCTV installation, repairs, and maintenance.
* Ensure CCTV systems are operational and report recurring issues.

**2. IT Systems & Technical Support**

* Identify and troubleshoot desktop, laptop, printer, POS system, and other IT-related issues.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers for timely resolution of technical problems.
* Maintain records of IT complaints, service requests, and resolution status.
* Provide technical support to store staff and office employees.

**3. Networking Coordination**

* Coordinate with internet service providers and networking vendors for connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi-Fi, router, and switch-related problems.
* Follow up on internet downtime, network installation, and connectivity restoration.
* Ensure stable network connectivity for store operations and office systems.

**4. IT Asset Tracking & Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets, including computers, laptops, printers, CCTV equipment, networking devices, and accessories.
* Track asset allocation, transfers between stores, repairs, replacements, and returns.
* Maintain asset records with serial numbers, locations, assigned users, and warranty details.
* Conduct periodic asset verification and report missing, damaged, or obsolete equipment.

**5. Electronic Equipment Maintenance**

* Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of electronic equipment across stores and offices.
* Ensure timely servicing of CCTV systems, biometric devices, printers, computers, networking equipment, and other electronic devices.
* Track equipment warranties, repair history, and replacement requirements.
* Identify recurring equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.

**6. Vendor Coordination & Management**

* Coordinate with IT, CCTV, networking, internet, and electronic equipment vendors.
* Raise service requests and follow up until issues are resolved.
* Obtain quotations for repairs, installations, replacements, and maintenance.
* Maintain vendor details, service records, quotations, invoices, and AMC documentation.
* Monitor vendor response time, service quality, turnaround time, and cost effectiveness.

**7. Vendor Findings & Reporting**

* Document technical issues identified by vendors and the actions recommended.
* Review vendor inspection reports, service reports, and maintenance findings.
* Escalate unresolved issues, repeated failures, and major technical concerns to management.
* Recommend suitable solutions to reduce downtime and maintenance costs.
* Prepare periodic reports on pending complaints, equipment status, vendor performance, and maintenance activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT administration, technical support, or infrastructure maintenance.
* Basic knowledge of CCTV systems, networking, computer hardware, and electronic equipment.
* Good coordination, follow-up, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple vendors and support multiple store locations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and inventory management.
* Willingness to travel to stores and office locations whenever required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely resolution of IT and CCTV complaints.
* Reduction in system downtime and recurring technical issues.
* Accuracy of IT asset inventory and tracking.
* Timely completion of preventive maintenance.
* Vendor response time and service quality.
* Timely closure of pending service requests.
* Effective control of repair, maintenance, and replacement costs.

**Preferred Candidate:** A hands-on professional who can independently coordinate IT support and maintenance activities across multiple retail outlets while ensuring minimum disruption to store operations.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Ensono**


Ensono is an expert technology adviser and managed service provider. As a relentless ally, we accelerate clients’ digital transformation to achieve business outcomes that stand to last. Our dedicated team helps organizations optimize today’s systems across any hybrid environment with services such as consulting, mainframe and application modernization, public cloud migration and cloud\-native development. With certified experts in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and recognized as Microsoft Datacenter Transformation Partner of the Year, Ensono has over 3500\+ associates globally and is headquartered in greater Chicago.


We care about your success, offering comprehensive strategic and managed services for mission\-critical applications. Our Advisory and Consulting services can help upfront with an application strategy or find the right places for your applications – whether it’s public, multi or hybrid cloud, or mainframe. And because we span across all mission\-critical platforms, we can meet you wherever you are in your digital transformation journey, with 24/7 support when you need it. We are your relentless ally, flexing with you when challenges emerge so you don’t feel stuck in place. With cross\-platform certifications and decades of experience, our technology experts have become an extension of your team so you’re continuously innovating – doing more with less while remaining secure. And that’s just the beginning**.**


We are seeking a **Linux L3 Engineer** to join **Linux Operations team**. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role responsible for managing, supporting, and optimizing Linux servers in production environments across **hosted, cloud (AWS/Azure), and remote infrastructure** settings. You will drive operational excellence, incident resolution, automation, and continuous improvement for critical business systems.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Incident \& Problem Management**


* Resolve **high\-priority incidents and major incidents (MIs)** with end\-to\-end ownership and minimal escalation
* Perform advanced root\-cause analysis and implement permanent, sustainable fixes
* Lead critical incident response, stabilization, and recovery efforts under pressure
* Provide clear technical direction and minimize business impact during outages

**Ownership \& Accountability**


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of service requests, incidents, and operational tasks
* Ensure proper validation, documentation, and closure of all work items
* Track MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) and drive continuous improvement
* Maintain high availability and compliance standards

**Process Excellence \& SOP Development**


* Create, review, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for recurring operational tasks
* Identify and document gaps in procedures and driving standardization across teams
* Support audit and compliance requirements through documented processes
* Contribute to operational runbooks and disaster recovery procedures

**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**


* Develop **Ansible playbooks, shell scripts, and automation** to reduce manual effort
* Support infrastructure\-as\-code initiatives and configuration management
* Identify repetitive tasks and drive automation to improve reliability and efficiency
* Support deployment and orchestration initiatives (Docker, Kubernetes, orchestration tools)

**Change \& Risk Management**


* Execute changes within **ServiceNow/change management frameworks**
* Perform impact analysis and risk assessment for infrastructure changes
* Coordinate with stakeholders during maintenance windows and service outages
* Validate blackout configurations and alert suppression during changes

**Mentorship \& Team Leadership**


* Act as a technical reference point and mentor for junior engineers
* Guide team members during complex troubleshooting and escalations
* Share knowledge through documentation, training, and collaborative problem\-solving
* Contribute to team capability development and cross\-training

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**


* Communicate effectively with internal teams and external clients
* Provide clear updates on incident status and resolution timelines
* Build trust through reliability, transparency, and technical credibility
* Support SLA compliance and service level agreements

  

**Required Qualifications**


**Technical Skills**


* **8\+ years** of production Linux/Unix administration and support experience
* Deep knowledge of **RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu** (including LTS versions and **lifecycle management**)
* Advanced troubleshooting skills: kernel, networking, storage, performance tuning
* Experience with **patching, security updates, and vulnerability remediation**
* Strong shell scripting (**Bash**) and **Ansible** automation experience
* Proficiency with **systemd, RPM/APT package management, and kernel modules**
* Hands\-on experience with **SSH, sudo, LDAP/Active Directory** authentication
* Solid understanding of **Linux security** (SELinux, AppArmor, firewalls, file permissions)

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**


* Experience with **AWS EC2 , GCP and Azure VMs** in production environments
* Understanding of **managed services** and **infrastructure as a service (IaaS)**
* Experience with **DNS, routing, load balancing** concepts

**Monitoring \& Logging**


* Experience with **Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, or similar** monitoring platforms
* Ability to configure alerts, dashboards, and log aggregation
* Understanding of **metrics, logs, traces (observability fundamentals)**

**Operational Skills**


* Strong incident response and problem\-solving under pressure
* Change management and risk assessment experience
* Documentation and SOP writing skills
* Ability to work in **24/7 on\-call rotations** (if required)

**Soft Skills**


* Excellent communication and technical documentation abilities
* Strong time management and prioritization in multi\-tasking environment
* Team player with mentoring mindset
* Detail\-oriented with focus on quality and compliance

**Shift Timings:** 24\*7 rotational shift and oncall support


We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request.
